description: Figure: determinant conservation map with in vivo-mutated residues flagged; table of what PMID 42832562 did and did not assay
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
det=pd.read_csv("rtt109_determinant_map.csv").fillna({"experimental_test_in_N_crassa":""})
order=["catalysis","autoacetylation","acetyl-CoA contact","Vps75 interface","Asf1-dependent loop","Asf1 C-tail"]
det["functional_class"]=pd.Categorical(det["functional_class"],categories=order,ordered=True)
det=det.sort_values(["functional_class","sc_residue"]).reset_index(drop=True)
cmap={"conserved (identical)":"#1b7837","conserved (similar)":"#a6dba0",
      "substituted (non-conservative)":"#d6604d","absent / unaligned (gap)":"#4d4d4d"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,7.5))
y=np.arange(len(det))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,det["blosum62"].fillna(-5),color=[cmap[s] for s in det["status"]],edgecolor="black",linewidth=.5)
for yy,(_,r) in zip(y,det.iterrows()):
    lab=f'{r["sc_residue"]} → {r["nc_residue"]}'
    ax.text(-5.6,yy,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8.5,family="monospace")
    if r["experimental_test_in_N_crassa"]:
        ax.text(r["blosum62"]+0.4,yy,"★ mutated in vivo",va="center",fontsize=8,color="#b2182b",weight="bold")
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlim(-10.5,14)
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
ax.set_xlabel("BLOSUM62 score of the aligned S. cerevisiae → N. crassa residue pair\n(bar at −5 = no aligned residue)")
ax.set_title("Rtt109 specificity determinants mapped from S. cerevisiae Q07794 onto N. crassa Q7S1R7\n"
             "global Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap −11/−1: 34.2% identity over 371 aligned columns",fontsize=10.5)
# class separators
bounds=det["functional_class"].astype(str).values
for k in range(1,len(det)):
    if bounds[k]!=bounds[k-1]: ax.axhline(y[k]+0.5,color="grey",lw=.7,ls=":")
for cls in order:
    idx=np.where(bounds==cls)[0]
    ax.text(13.5,y[idx].mean(),cls,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9,style="italic",color="#333333")
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,fc=c,ec="k",lw=.5) for c in cmap.values()]
ax.legend(h,list(cmap.keys()),loc="lower left",fontsize=8.5,framealpha=.95)
ax.text(13.5,y[-1]-1.6,"★ D145, D304, D305 were mutated to build the catalytic-dead\nallele used in PMID 42832562, matching this mapping",
        ha="right",va="top",fontsize=8.5,color="#b2182b")
ax.set_ylim(-3,len(det))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- artifact table: what the decisive paper did and did not assay ----
assayed=pd.DataFrame([
 ("H3K56ac","hH3 K56R and hH3 K56Q point mutants, H3K27me3 ChIP-seq + western","tested","neither mutant phenocopies Δrtt109; H3K27me3 levels unaffected","excluded as the relevant product"),
 ("RTT109 catalytic activity","rtt109 D145A and D145A-DD304-305AA at csr-1 in Δrtt109","tested","fail to rescue H3K27me3; loss ≥ Δrtt109","required"),
 ("NAF-2 (Vps75 homolog)","Δnaf-2, co-IP/LC-MS/MS, AlphaFold3 ipTM 0.67","tested","interacts with RTT109 but is dispensable for H3K27me3","excluded as the relevant partner"),
 ("ASF-1","Δasf-1 heterokaryon, H3K27me3-gene expression","tested","no RTT109-ASF-1 interaction detected; see paper for Δasf-1 effect","interaction not detected"),
 ("H3K9ac","none","NOT assayed","no measurement reported anywhere in the article","candidate, untested"),
 ("H3K14ac","none","NOT assayed","no measurement reported anywhere in the article","candidate, untested"),
 ("H3K18ac","none","NOT assayed","no measurement reported anywhere in the article","candidate, untested"),
 ("H3K23ac","none","NOT assayed","no measurement reported anywhere in the article","candidate, untested"),
 ("H3K27ac","none","NOT assayed","no measurement reported anywhere in the article","candidate, untested"),
 ("non-histone substrates","none","NOT assayed","no acetylome / mass-spec PTM survey reported","candidate, untested"),
],columns=["mark_or_factor","assay_used_in_PMID_42832562","status","result","bearing_on_seed_hypothesis"])
assayed.to_csv("pmid42832562_assay_coverage.csv",index=False)
print(assayed.to_string(index=False))
